description: This file defines an abstract base controller class for the OrangeHRM admin plugin, providing methods for permission checks and context setup related to user roles and data groups.

classes.name: BaseAdminController
classes.description: An abstract controller class that handles permission checking and context data setup for admin functionalities within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data group identifiers used for capability checks; defaults to an empty array.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has read permission for the data groups relevant to the capability check.

methods.name: setPermissionsForController
methods.description: Sets permission data into the Vue context for use in the frontend, based on provided data groups.
